entries.ai_recommendation_summary: The AI recommended using an always-on environment for immediate testing.
entries.rationale: Immediate access is required which is what the Always-on sandbox is made for.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: The AI suggested reserving a dedicated sandbox for isolated network configuration.
